strings.zh: 志霸『其实早在{NEWLINE}你帮忙解救金黄市之后,{CLEAR}我就想跟你较量一下了。{SCROLL}志霸『你是喜欢单打还是双打？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Bruno: Truth is, ever since you helped{NEWLINE}save Saffron City, I’ve wanted to test{CLEAR}my strength against you.{SCROLL}Bruno: Do you prefer singles or{NEWLINE}doubles?{SCROLL}
strings.notes: League branch: #0–17 are the Elite Four rematch/training lines (Bruno's room). Rocket-occupation branch: #18–42 (Proton and Petrel); #18–30 = ‘one at a time’ path, #31–32 = ‘together’ path.

strings.zh: 志霸『跟强者对战是我的爱好,{NEWLINE}咱们来好好较量一下！{SCROLL}志霸『你是喜欢单打还是双打？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Bruno: Battling the strong is my{NEWLINE}passion. Let’s have a real contest!{SCROLL}Bruno: Do you prefer singles or{NEWLINE}doubles?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 志霸『胜负不重要,{NEWLINE}重要的是痛快地打一场！
strings.en: Bruno: Winning or losing doesn’t matter.{NEWLINE}What matters is a good, hard battle!

strings.zh: 全地区的观众{NEWLINE}都会通过我的摄像机看到你的英姿哟！
strings.en: Viewers across the region will see your{NEWLINE}finest moments through my camera!

strings.zh: 需要我帮您恢复精灵吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Shall I heal your Pokémon?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 您的精灵已经恢复了。
strings.en: Your Pokémon are fully healed.

strings.zh: 您好{VAR:0103:0}大人,{NEWLINE}请问您是要恢复精灵{CLEAR}还是前往下一个房间？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hello, {VAR:0103:0}.{SCROLL}Would you like me to heal your Pokémon,{NEWLINE}or will you go on to the next room?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 单打
strings.en: Singles
strings.notes: v3 TM: 6 source(s); other variants: 1 more v3 TM candidate (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 双打
strings.en: Doubles
strings.notes: v3 TM: 5 source(s); other variants: 2 more v3 TM candidates (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 志霸『没问题,来吧！
strings.en: Bruno: No problem. Come on!

strings.zh: 恢复精灵
strings.en: Heal Pokémon

strings.zh: 前往下一个房间
strings.en: Go to the next room

strings.zh: 没事了
strings.en: Never mind

strings.zh: 好的,我现在为您恢复。
strings.en: Certainly. I’ll heal them now.

strings.zh: 好的,我现在为您开门。
strings.en: Certainly. I’ll open the door for you{NEWLINE}now.

strings.zh: 今天先不打了
strings.en: Not today

strings.zh: 门已经开了,您随时可以通过。
strings.en: The door is open. You may go through{NEWLINE}anytime.

strings.zh: 你的精灵数量不够,{NEWLINE}无法进行双打。
strings.en: You don’t have enough Pokémon for a{NEWLINE}double battle.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『兰斯,伦达！{NEWLINE}外面的火箭队都被我们打败了。{CLEAR}现在轮到你们两个了！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Proton, Petrel!{SCROLL}We’ve beaten all of Team Rocket{NEWLINE}outside. Now it’s your turn!

strings.zh: 兰斯『听到了吗伦达？{NEWLINE}这个冠军想要打败咱们两个呢。
strings.en: Proton: Hear that, Petrel? This{NEWLINE}Champion wants to beat the two of us.

strings.zh: 伦达『你个狗娘养的死爹玩意儿,{NEWLINE}还以为我们是以前的实力吗？{CLEAR}老子现在不仅拥有了闪电鸟,{CLEAR}还借用老大的阿尔宙斯{CLEAR}强化了原有的精灵。{CLEAR}早就不是你这种平民冠军{CLEAR}可以打败的了！
strings.en: Petrel: You fatherless son of a bitch,{NEWLINE}think we’re as weak as we used to be?{SCROLL}I’ve got Zapdos now, and I’ve used the{NEWLINE}Boss’s Arceus to power up the Pokémon{CLEAR}I already had.{SCROLL}A commoner Champion like you can’t beat{NEWLINE}us anymore!
strings.notes: 狗娘养的死爹玩意儿 kept at full strength (‘fatherless son of a bitch’), per D-0627.

strings.zh: 兰斯『为了展示我们火箭队的气度,{NEWLINE}今天给你一个选择死法的机会。{CLEAR}你是希望被我们轮流揍死,{CLEAR}还是希望被我们一起合力揍死？
strings.en: Proton: To show Team Rocket’s{NEWLINE}generosity, today we’ll let you choose{CLEAR}how you die.{SCROLL}Do you want us to beat you to death one{NEWLINE}at a time, or all together?

strings.zh: 你们轮流上吧
strings.en: One at a time, then

strings.zh: 你们一起上吧
strings.en: Come at me together

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『训练家的强大是由内而外的,{NEWLINE}你们只会依靠传说中的精灵,{CLEAR}不过就是虚有其表罢了。{CLEAR}就算你们轮流跟我打车轮战,{CLEAR}我也不会输给的！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: A Trainer’s strength comes{NEWLINE}from within.{SCROLL}All you do is lean on Legendary Pokémon.{NEWLINE}It’s nothing but a hollow show.{SCROLL}Even if you take turns ganging up on me,{NEWLINE}I won’t lose!

strings.zh: 伦达『妈了个逼的,{NEWLINE}那就让我杀杀你的威风！
strings.en: Petrel: Motherfucker! Then I’ll knock{NEWLINE}you down a peg!

strings.zh: 伦达『我操！怎么回事！！{NEWLINE}闪电鸟,闪电鸟！！！
strings.en: Petrel: Fuck! What the hell?! Zapdos,{NEWLINE}Zapdos!!!

strings.zh: 兰斯『冷静伦达,看我收拾他。
strings.en: Proton: Calm down, Petrel. Watch me{NEWLINE}take care of him.

strings.zh: 兰斯『冷静伦达,看我收拾她。
strings.en: Proton: Calm down, Petrel. Watch me{NEWLINE}take care of her.

strings.zh: 兰斯『不……连我的火焰鸟……{NEWLINE}还有那么多强化精灵,{CLEAR}都败下阵来了吗……？
strings.en: Proton: No...{SCROLL}Even my Moltres... and all those{NEWLINE}enhanced Pokémon... all beaten...?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你们彻底输了,{NEWLINE}去牢里好好反省自己的罪行吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You’ve lost completely.{SCROLL}Go to prison and think long and hard{NEWLINE}about your crimes.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『像你们这种{NEWLINE}只会借助外力的弱小训练家,{CLEAR}就算一起上我也不怕,{CLEAR}放马过来吧！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Weak Trainers like you who can{NEWLINE}only rely on borrowed power don’t{CLEAR}scare me, even together.{SCROLL}Bring it on!

strings.zh: 兰斯『真是个狂妄的冠军,{NEWLINE}今天一定要好好杀杀你的威风！
strings.en: Proton: What an arrogant Champion.{SCROLL}Today we’re knocking you down a peg for{NEWLINE}sure!

strings.zh: 是冠军大人赢了！
strings.en: The Champion won!

strings.zh: 太好了,冠军大人来救我们了！
strings.en: Thank goodness, the Champion came to{NEWLINE}save us!

strings.zh: 呜呜呜,我爱你,冠军大人！
strings.en: Waaah, I love you, Champion!

strings.zh: 好啊,好啊,这下精灵联盟有救了。
strings.en: Yes, yes! Now the Pokémon League is{NEWLINE}saved.

strings.zh: 伦达『你这个狗日的东西,{NEWLINE}坂木老大会替我们报仇的！
strings.en: Petrel: You fucking dog, Boss Giovanni{NEWLINE}will avenge us!
strings.notes: 狗日的东西 kept crude (‘You fucking dog’), per D-0627.

strings.zh: 兰斯『就算打败了我们,{NEWLINE}火箭队还有8位干部,{CLEAR}还有坂木老大！{CLEAR}你绝不可能打败他们所有人！
strings.en: Proton: Even if you beat us, Team{NEWLINE}Rocket still has eight Executives, and{CLEAR}Boss Giovanni!{SCROLL}There’s no way you can beat them all!

strings.zh: 谢谢冠军大人来救我们！
strings.en: Thank you for saving us, Champion!

strings.zh: 火箭队真是太可怕了……
strings.en: Team Rocket is so terrifying...

strings.zh: 冠军大人,人家好怕,呜呜呜……
strings.en: Champion, I’m so scared...{NEWLINE}Boo-hoo-hoo...
strings.notes: RV026: meaning: 人家好怕 is present tense ('I'm so scared'), not 'I was'

strings.zh: 年轻人,就靠你了,加油啊。
strings.en: Young one, it’s all up to you now. Good{NEWLINE}luck.
